_comment: ICICI Bank — Real-world profile derived from FY2025 Annual Report (year ended March 31, 2025)
_source: ICICI Bank FY2025 Annual Report (icici.bank.in), Business Standard Q4FY25, equitymaster.com analysis
_note_balance_sheet: Total Assets Rs 21,18,240 cr; Net Advances Rs 13,41,766 cr (13.28% YoY); Total Deposits Rs 16,10,348 cr (13.98% YoY). LDR 83.3%. Largest private sector bank by advances.
_note_deposits: CASA ~43% of deposits (mid-40s target). Current/Demand ~17.5%, Savings ~25.5%, Term ~57%. ICICI is stronger in current accounts than PSU banks due to large corporate/SME franchise and salary account base.
_note_exposure: Retail ~56% of loan book (incl. home loans ~25%), SME ~20.5% (fastest growing, 30% YoY), Corporate ~20%, Kisan/Agri ~3.5% mapped to RETAIL_OTHER. ICICI is India's largest private mortgage lender.
_note_credit_quality: GNPA improved to 1.67% (from 2.16% in FY2024) — best-in-class among large Indian banks. Net NPA 0.39%. Reflects strong underwriting, high secured retail mix, and clean corporate book post-2019 NPA cycle.
_note_pnl: NIM 4.32% (best among large banks — reflects high retail/SME mix and MCLR repricing benefit). PAT Rs 47,227 cr (FY2025). ROA ~2.23%, ROE ~18%. Cost-income ~39% (highly efficient private bank).
_note_capital: CRAR 16.55%, CET1 15.94% as of March 2025. Comfortably above RBI minimums. Highest CET1 among large Indian banks — reflects strong internal capital generation via 2%+ ROA.
